sourceRefs.locator: Interview and transcript, 17 July 2020, AA00081353/00001. At 07:27–08:46 Moore recalls her birthplace and date, at 14:52–18:00 her father's farriery in Barbados and blacksmithing in the Balboa shops and her older sister, at 23:10 the shared facilities, at 39:38 the commissary books, at 57:45–58:18 her work and at 59:04–1:00:24 Manuel's Chinese shop and credit.

Modern American History 7 (1), pp. 131–135. Opening pages, especially note 3 on the Moore oral history and the 1920 and 1930 censuses, notes 8–10 on food, domestic work and remittances, figure 1 and note 11 on Adica Moore's work. The 22 January 1965 Spillway photograph documents her later career.
La Boca neighbourhood record, Location, 8.94811° N, 79.5613° W. Modern neighbourhood locator at the Pacific entrance. No individual family's house, shop or 1910 workplace is claimed.

labels.en: Making a home in La Boca

note.de: Emily Amelia Lewis reist zu William Edward Griffith nach Panama. Die Erinnerungen ihrer Tochter Adica Moore führen aus der gemeinsamen Wohnung in La Boca in Manuels Lebensmittelladen und an ihren späteren Arbeitsplatz im Krankenhaus.
note.en: Emily Amelia Lewis joins William Edward Griffith in Panama. Their daughter Adica Moore's recollections lead from the family home in La Boca to Manuel's grocery shop and her own later workplace at the hospital.
